title: ICF HUB: An open semantic infrastructure connecting persons and social opportunities via ICF
description: Umbrella repository of the ICF HUB project: vision, concept model (IHR-001), and the IHR process (IHR-000). ICF HUB consists of two deliberately small public layers (icf-registry and icf-exchange-spec) on top of which anyone can build applications. Drafted and published by Mirai no Design Inc. (Fukui, Japan) as a defensive publication under CC BY 4.0.
